meaning.en: To happen at the same time or during the same period.

meaning.en: To occupy the same relative position or the same area in space.
meaning.vi: Để chiếm cùng một vị trí tương đối hoặc cùng một khu vực trong không gian.

meaning.en: To occur at the same time; take up the same period of time.

Để giống hệt nhau; tương ứng chính xác.

sentences.en: The declared aim of the author 1 was to offer a complete solution of the great mechanical problem presented by the solar system, and to bring theory to coincide so closely with observation that empirical equations should no longer find a place in astronomical tables.
